setup: 1. Identify problem. 2. MVP definition. 3. Legal incorporation (Private Limited / LLC).
investment: Bootstrap: $1k-$5k. Pre-seed: $50k-$200k. Focus on minimal burn rate.
staff: Co-founders (Tech + Business), 1-2 Generalist Engineers, Growth Hacker.
marketing: Content marketing, Product Hunt launch, early adopter communities (Reddit, Discord).
growthStrategy: Achieve Product-Market Fit. Track CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) vs LTV (Lifetime Value).
commonMistakes: Scaling before Product-Market Fit. Building too many features instead of testing the core value proposition.
expansionRoadmap: 1. Seed Funding. 2. Hire dedicated sales. 3. Expand geographically.
